libs.note: BH-6308: when a slice merge finds no open child issue, sco_settle decides from the merged plan's Requirements coverage matrix. Covered closes the parent with the merged PR links; uncovered or undecided files ONE child with the rest and then closes the parent. Called from issue_slice_settle and mc_close_shipped. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply slice-closeout.

knobs.zero_means: the no-children path of BH-4662 and BH-5961 runs as before: the parent stays open with ai-build
knobs.note: 1 = a slice close-out that finds no open child never leaves the parent open with no child. Read by sco_knob.
